decision: Owner selected 1A 2A 3A 4A 5B 6A 7A 8A 9A 10A. Prompt QA: dynamic in-scene action first, camera secondary.
shot_motion_design: Use actual physical motion of subjects, water, light and foliage; no artificial zoom-only photo slideshow.

scenes.action_priority: Cruise boat, rippling water and foreground flowers, not camera movement
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. A small cruise boat on the left glides naturally through calm Ha Long Bay, leaving expanding ripples and a gentle wake. Soft clouds drift across the glowing sky and bougainvillea leaves sway in the sea breeze. Sunlight flickers on moving water. Camera holds nearly still with a very subtle forward drift; the cliffs remain fixed. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.action_priority: Mist movement, flowing water, foliage motion
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. Thin morning mist slowly flows between the layered mountains and over the rice terraces. The river surface moves downstream with tiny highlights; leaves in the near tree canopy flutter in a light breeze. Sunlight filters through shifting clouds. Camera makes a very slight lateral glide without changing the valley, fields, or river. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.voice_text: В одном путешествии вас ждут ночь на корабле среди скал бухты Халонг,
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. The white multi-deck cruise vessel moves forward through the emerald water of Ha Long Bay, producing a realistic trailing wake, curling ripples and reflections. A light breeze stirs the surrounding treetops and the soft cloud haze drifts. Camera gently tracks the real forward boat motion; preserve hull, railings, windows and limestone cliff shapes. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.action_priority: Sunlight evolution, sea reflections, leaf movement
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. Warm sunrise light gradually spreads across the existing cruise deck. The bay water ripples below, its golden reflection sparkling and shifting; delicate flower leaves and potted greenery on the deck sway naturally in the morning breeze. Clouds drift slowly beyond fixed karst islands. Keep the deck structure and railing solid; almost static camera. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.voice_text: и храмы Ангкора, где корни деревьев переплелись с древней кладкой.
scenes.action_priority: Living foliage and changing sunlight; monumental architecture stays still
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. Sunlight filters through the canopy and slowly shifting leaf shadows play across the ancient Angkor stone wall and enormous intertwined tree roots. Small leaves and nearby vines sway in the breeze; fine dust motes drift in the beams of light. The tree trunk, roots, carvings and stones stay completely solid and stationary. Subtle breathing-camera move only. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.voice_text: Это организованный тур в сопровождении Татьяны Горфман.
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. The existing small group of older adult tourists walks forward at a natural relaxed pace along the Angkor stone path. Feet take grounded steps, arms swing gently, hats and loose clothing respond to a light breeze. Dappled leaf shadows move over the path. A steady following camera accompanies the group's real movement; keep anatomy and temple walls consistent, no new people. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

scenes.voice_text: С 12 по 29 января 2027 года, вылет из Тель-Авива рейсами Etihad через Абу-Даби.
scenes.action_priority: Aircraft actually advances, camera follows, landmark stays fixed
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. The passenger airplane already visible in the sky continues a smooth realistic climb forward and slightly upward, gradually moving across the sunset sky. Its wings and fuselage remain rigid, with a subtle atmospheric haze and drifting clouds. The lakeside Hanoi landmark below remains stationary; the water reflects soft moving light. Camera tracks the airplane gently, no invented branding or aircraft. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.
scenes.note: Selected still contains airplane and Hanoi landmark; do not invent Etihad branding.

scenes.action_priority: Visible steam and food surface, subtle ambient movement
scenes.prompt_en: Five-second photorealistic image-to-video animation. Delicate steam rises in swirling strands from the hot Vietnamese pho bowl on the foreground table, while a few surface ripples and oily highlights shift gently in the broth. Leaves, flowers and hanging lanterns in the background move slightly in a natural breeze. Preserve the exact food, bowls, spring rolls, table setting and empty chairs; minimal steady camera drift. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.

Gentle waves and golden reflections shimmer; thin clouds travel across the warm sunset sky while foreground leaves stir lightly. Keep the broad uncluttered sky and water area open for a price overlay to be added later. Mostly locked camera. One continuous take. No cuts, no still-photo zoom effect, no title cards, letters, graphics, overlays, or scene substitutions.
